feed.title: All In On McDonald's Stock? Social Media User Wants Advice on Fast Food Giant, Investors Aren't Lovin' It
feed.summary: A social media user, Nik Hulewsky, sought advice on whether to invest his entire net worth in McDonald's (NYSE: MCD) stock, citing a 3.3% dividend yield and perceived low valuation. While he initially highlighted strong revenue and operating income growth, a community note clarified these figures were from pandemic lows. Investor responses largely expressed skepticism due to changing consumer tastes, high McDonald's prices, and the impact of weight-loss drugs, leading Hulewsky to purchase only 10 shares instead of going "all in."

feed.title: Ford Sales Slide 6.6% After Model Phase-Outs
feed.summary: Ford Motor Company reported a 6.6% year-over-year decline in third-quarter U.S. vehicle sales, primarily due to planned phase-outs of the Escape and Lincoln Corsair models. Despite the overall sales dip, Ford estimated an increase in its retail market share to 12.1% when excluding the phased-out models. The company saw strong performance in its F-Series trucks, Maverick Hybrid, and Bronco sales, and maintained its adjusted EBIT guidance for 2026 despite a short-term supplier issue affecting F-150 production.

feed.title: PolyPid regains European rights for D-PLEX after deal ends By Investing.com

feed.title: UnitedHealth and Humana cutting Medicare Advantage plans in 2027
feed.summary: UnitedHealth and Humana are discontinuing Medicare Advantage plans covering over one million seniors, with CVS Health's Aetna and Centene also scaling back. This move is a response to rising medical costs and insufficient government reimbursement, leading to insurers pulling back from less profitable markets for the 2027 enrollment year. Affected members will need to select new plans, and UnitedHealth will restructure its offerings to focus on lower-cost options.

feed.title: Eversource reaches 500,000 smart meter milestone in Massachusetts
feed.summary: Eversource has installed its 500,000th smart meter in Massachusetts, marking a significant milestone in its statewide rollout aimed at providing customers with greater insight into their energy consumption and modernizing the electric grid. These smart meters enable customers to monitor their energy usage, receive high-bill alerts, and contribute to a more responsive electric system. The company expects to substantially complete the statewide rollout by the end of 2027, with high customer participation and an opt-out rate of less than 1%.

feed.title: Kroger Makes Major Change at All Its Stores and Customers Will Notice Immediately
feed.summary: Kroger is implementing a significant change across all its stores by requiring its nearly 400,000 employees to wear new company-issued uniforms. This marks the first time in over a decade that employees will not wear their own clothing, with specific attire for general staff and store leaders. Customers are expected to notice this change immediately as it rolls out across Kroger's 2,700+ stores, including its Fred Meyer and Harris Teeter brands.

feed.title: Tesla: Shares Rise on Third-Quarter Deliveries Ahead of Consensus Estimates
feed.summary: Tesla reported third-quarter deliveries of 486,532 vehicles, slightly down from 2025 but still ahead of consensus estimates, causing shares to rise 4%. The company anticipates around 10% deliveries growth in 2026, with upcoming earnings expected to provide updates on robotaxi plans, FSD version 15, and the Optimus humanoid robot.

feed.title: Regeneron Highlights Promising Ovarian Cancer, Muscle Preservation Trial Data
feed.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals shared promising Phase 1/2 clinical trial results for ubamatamab in recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer, showing a 73% objective response rate. Additionally, Phase 2 COURAGE trial data for trevogrumab combined with semaglutide demonstrated muscle preservation in weight loss, with lower doses retaining significant lean mass. The company plans further studies and regulatory discussions for these therapies.
